synthesis.answer: If you remove only the "Elimina" call from the credit flow (Option A: SAP Methods\Order\OrderMethods.cs:705-709), nothing changes in how the flow behaves. Its result is thrown away (:708), and HandlePromoCodeAsync catches every exception and returns "err" (:1033, :1168-1172). So the credit header, the article lines, the error handling and the "Concluido" response to Magento (:1809-1814) all stay the same, and neither Magento nor the DMZ reads anything from it. The only side effect is on data: ServicioSAP stops stamping FechaUtilizacion/IdEcommerce and stops inserting a new free row in SigMavi VentasCupones (:1098, :1147-1159). That row is the only place a credit web order gets tied to its promoter. The credit header's Agente/Codigo stay NULL (:803-840), order.Agente is only used on the cash path (:1852, :2367, :2621->:2790), and LAN also recorded the promoter only through SpVTASVentaCupon. No code in any repo reads either coupon table, but commissions or reports outside the repos could not be checked (NO EVIDENCE). The burn never limited reuse anyway: LAN's ValidarCupon only returns 0 or 1, so "Utilizado" can never come back (SpVTASVentaCupon.sql:60-113). So the Q8 question about LAN's rules (stamp only the newest free row vs ServicioSAP stamping all free rows at :1098) stops mattering. Also deleting HandlePromoCodeAsync and GET order/validatecupon (Option B) breaks no live caller. But the Magento checkout still blocks the order unless the promoter code gets an exact "OK" from DMZ credit/codigoPromocion, and that is true under both options.

sweeps.summary:
Short answer: removing only the "Elimina" call from the credit flow (Option A) changes nothing that Magento or the rest of the flow can see. The same credit header and line rows get written, Magento gets the same response and errors are handled the same way. The side effects are data only, plus less work per order.

(1) Flow control is unchanged. The call at SAP Methods\Order\OrderMethods.cs:705-709 discards its result. HandlePromoCodeAsync can never throw: its whole body is inside try/catch (:1033/:1168-1172) and it returns "err" on failure. So the catch at :711-717 only ever catches InsertCreditArticlesAsync failures. The response (:759, :1809-1814, Controllers\OrderController.cs:28-35) has no promo field.

(2) Data change. ServicioSAP stops marking coupons used (FechaUtilizacion, IdEcommerce = incrementId) and stops creating a new free coupon in SigMavi VentasCupones (:1098, :1147). That UPDATE is the only place ServicioSAP records the promoter against a credit order:
- The credit header columns Agente, Codigo and CodigoRecomendador are never filled (OrderMethods.cs:803-840 into SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs:287/292/293).
- The top-level order.Agente, which Magento fills with the same promoter code on credit orders (Magento OrderManagement.php:510-512, :728-729; captured CRED511270 has Agente = codigo_promotor = "E016881"), is ignored in the credit branch (:1792-1815).
- LAN was the same: its SP call passes no @Agente (LAN CreditMethods.cs:150-188), so LAN also recorded the promoter only in VTASCVentaCupon.
- No reader of either coupon table was found in any repo.

(3) Less work per promoter order. Removing the call drops up to 3 SigMavi connections and up to 4 synchronous HTTP calls from order/new: SuccessFactors, the AWS catalog, URL_BP_API AS_GET_ZQBP_AGENTE and S4 ZAPI_SUCURSALES_SRV. Some of these use a plain `new HttpClient()` with no timeout set. Runbook bugs B3 and B6 also disappear from the credit path. No sap.log lines are lost, because this path only writes to Console.

(4) This is a deliberate divergence from LAN, which ran the same step (LAN CreditMethods.cs:203-206). Given the "same as LAN" rule (runbook §22.7), it should be recorded as a deprecation decision.

Option B (delete HandlePromoCodeAsync entirely):
- OrderController.ValidateCupon, route GET /order/validatecupon/{codigo}, must go too, or the build breaks. No caller was found. DMZ forwards POST credit/codigoPromocion through Curl.Post to URL_INTELISIS. Magento posts {codigo, opcion, idMagento} to its own configured URL and expects "OK"/"Erroneo"/"Utilizado", which is not the shape this route uses.
- Models\SAP\Order\CouponModels.cs is already dead code (zero references). It can go with its csproj entry at :393.
- These must all stay because other code uses them: the SigMavi connection (GetCondicionAsync reads CondicionesCredVtaLinea for credit line pricing, :875/:3338), URL_BP_API (credit header phone check, SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs:487), URL_ANDROID_API and GetSuccessFactorEmployeeAsync (route partner/successfactor/employee/{userId}), GetConfiguracionCatalogoAsync, AccountMethods.GetSucursalAsync, and the _productMethods field.
- InfoClienteRequest.codigo_promotor has no reader left after either option. Keeping or deleting it is safe, since no global MissingMemberHandling is configured.

Still open: Magento still has the promoter field at checkout, validates guest codes, and sends codigoPromocion "Elimina" from the Credilana/ClientCredit flows. All of that goes to a configured URL (DMZ, then LAN), not to ServicioSAP. If only the credit-flow part is deprecated, Option B deletes the only ServicioSAP code that the migration docs list for E-46 credit/codigoPromocion.

Codigo promotor and codigo recomendador are separate. codigo_promotor never feeds the CodigoRecomendador column, in ServicioSAP or in LAN. The recomendador uses its own CREDIDCodigoRecomendador table and SP in LAN.

sweeps.summary:
Magento/DMZ sweep: neither option breaks Magento or the DMZ. The customer-facing problem is the checkout, which still enforces the promoter code, and that does not depend on either option.

(1) Yes, Magento still sends infoCliente.codigo_promotor. registerCreditQuote always sets the key (OrderManagement.php:710-718), and registerOrder sets it for non-guest credit orders (:461-468). The value comes from the payment field promoCodeN (credito-checkout-functions.js:319-326, omnipro_pago_credito-method.js:607-615, DataAssignObserver.php:45-55). If that is empty, it falls back to quote.bank, which the validation call writes (CreditoManagement.php:601). The two captured credit payloads carry "codigo_promotor":"" (magento_payloads.md:26,55). The same code is also sent as body.Agente (OrderManagement.php:505-513, 728-729). ServicioSAP uses Agente on its own path, as SAP partner Z1 and Zusuariopos (OrderMethods.cs:2364-2370, 2786-2790), so the promoter still reaches SAP after either option. The DMZ passes both fields through unchanged: infoCliente is a Dictionary<string,string> (DMZ Models/OrderRequest.cs:24,32) and goes to ServicioSAP order/new through PostSAP (OrdersController.cs:196).

(2) Yes, the checkout calls a validation. It posts to Magento's own REST route /rest/V1/omnipro-credito/codigoPromocion with opcion 'ValidarCupon' from three copies of the code (credito-checkout-functions.js:256-295, the muebles_america checkout-data-resolver.js:256-295, and the guest renderer omnipro_pago_credito-method.js:785-805). The Magento backend then posts {codigo, opcion, idMagento} to the configured URL cupon_promotion (CreditoManagement.php:589-610). That URL's value is only in the database. The checkout does block. When the customer ticks 'Código de promotor', only the exact string "OK" lets the order through. "Erroneo" and "Utilizado" show an error. Any other string, null or a JSON object (which makes the `.replace` call throw) leaves the order blocked: the dedicated checkout shows 'Código inválido' when the SMS is validated, and the guest path does nothing and shows nothing. Unticking the box lets the order go through.

(3) The DMZ has exactly one coupon route: credit/codigoPromocion (CreditController.cs:126-138). It relays to URL_INTELISIS with curl.Post. On errors, curl.Post returns the exception text, and the route still answers HTTP 200 (Curl.cs:93-113). In the DMZ Web.config on disk, URL_INTELISIS is https://localhost:44399/ (Web.config:17), which is ServicioSAP's IIS Express port (ServicioSap.csproj:21,503). The LAN production URL is commented out (Web.config:16). ServicioSAP has no credit/codigoPromocion route; LAN has one (LAN CreditController.cs:124-141). No DMZ or Magento code calls ServicioSAP's GET order/validatecupon/{codigo}. Its reply is {status: OK|NO_VALIDO|err}, which does not match what Magento expects anyway.

(4) Option A (remove the "Elimina" call from the credit flow): no visible change in Magento or the DMZ. The call's result is already thrown away, all its exceptions are caught (OrderMethods.cs:701-717, 1168-1172), and the order response does not depend on it. Removing it only saves time on each credit order. It also changes no checkout message. LAN validation runs SpVTASVentaCupon on MAVICUBOS/IntelisisTmp (LAN Connection.cs:26), while ServicioSAP's burn writes SIGMavi on DEVMAVI (ConexionSQL.cs:79, Web.config:159-161). And in the SP copy we have, ValidarCupon only ever returns 0 or 1 (SpVTASVentaCupon.sql:60-113), so "Utilizado" never comes back. Nothing in Magento or the DMZ reads the coupon table. Option B (also remove HandlePromoCodeAsync and order/validatecupon): no Magento or DMZ caller, so nothing breaks there. Only the Hoppscotch collections that call that route would get 404.

The real side effect of calling this "deprecated": the Magento checkout still enforces the promoter code and depends on the DMZ credit/codigoPromocion path. If that path points at ServicioSAP (as in the Web.config on disk), or LAN is retired, anyone who ticks the box cannot finish the order. To really deprecate it, Magento has to change (hide the checkbox and remove validatePromoCode/validateCupon), or some backend has to keep answering "OK". Codigo promotor and codigo recomendador are separate in the code: ProductosMX sends them in data[72] and data[69] (CreditMxManagement.php:457,459).

sweeps.summary:
Short answer: removing the promoter-coupon "Elimina" call from the ServicioSAP credit flow does not change how the flow works. It changes data in one table, SIGMAVI VentasCupones. The code has no reader of that table, but readers outside the code (Intelisis or SIGMAVI reports, commissions, payroll) could not be checked.

Path roots used below: SAP = \\172.16.214.58\sap\ServicioSAP\ServicioSap\ServicioSap, LAN = \\172.16.214.58\sap\LAN\WebApiMagento, DMZ = \\172.16.214.58\sap\DMZ\WebApiMagento, MAG = \\172.16.214.58\sap\Magento248\Magento248\app\code, SPS = \\172.16.214.58\sap\.agents\skills\lan-sap-migration\SPsOrden, DOC = \\172.16.214.58\sap\.agents\skills\lan-sap-migration.

(A) Removing only the call at SAP Methods/Order/OrderMethods.cs:705-709:
- The flow ignores the call's result (:708), and HandlePromoCodeAsync never throws because its outer catch returns "err" (:1168-1172).
- The request insert (CrearSolicitudCreditoAsync :803-840) and the article lines (:703) do not use it. The reply to Magento stays the same (:1809-1814).
- The promoter code is written nowhere else in the credit path: there is no Agente in the credit request (SAP :803-840; LAN Metodos/CreditMethods.cs:150-188), and the credit path returns before order.Agente is used (SAP :1792-1815 vs :1852; LAN Metodos/OrderMethods.cs:623-649 vs :652).
- The only effect: credit orders stop stamping FechaUtilizacion/IdEcommerce in SIGMAVI VentasCupones (:1098) and stop inserting a new row for the same code (:1147-1148). That removes the only record tying a credit web order to a promoter.
- Removing it also drops up to five external calls per promo order, and the bugs B3/B6 and root cause #6 stop applying to the credit flow.

(B) Removing HandlePromoCodeAsync and the GET order/validatecupon/{codigo} route (SAP Controllers/OrderController.cs:102-120):
- Also safe at runtime. Nothing in MAG app/code, DMZ or LAN calls the route; only the Hoppscotch collections and planning docs mention it.
- Magento checks the code at checkout through its own REST call. That call goes to the configured URL `cupon_promotion`, whose value is not in the code. DMZ credit/codigoPromocion forwards to LAN (DMZ CreditController.cs:126-138, Helper/Curl.cs:22,93, Web.config:17). The contract is also different: POST returning OK/Erroneo/Utilizado, versus ServicioSAP's GET returning {status: OK/NO_VALIDO/err}.
- Helpers that stay in use: GetSuccessFactorEmployeeAsync (BusinessPartnerController.cs:175), GetSucursalAsync (AccountController.cs:52), URL_BP_API (BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:204). Models/SAP/Order/CouponModels.cs is already dead code.

How the coupon works in LAN:
- The coupon code is the employee number itself (Codigo = Agente, SPS SpVTASVentaCupon.sql:153-155; captured payload CRED511270: codigo_promotor = Agente = "E016881", DOC MappingMetods/Manual Tecnico Peticiones Hoppscotch 01092026.md:879).
- "Elimina" stamps the newest free row, then always inserts a new free row (SP:115-136). ValidarCupon only ever returns 0 or 1 (SP:62-113), so the "Utilizado" answer LAN checks for (CreditMethods.cs:442-445) can never happen.
- So marking a coupon used never limited reuse. It is only a log of which order used which employee's code.

The feature is not switched off anywhere in code:
- The ServicioSAP call is live with no flag.
- LAN calls it (CreditMethods.cs:203-206, 480-483).
- Magento still shows the checkbox, validates the code, and burns coupons through LAN in the Credilana, ClientCredit and ProductosMX flows.
- The SPs were still being changed in Oct 2025 and Jan 2026 (SPVTASPedidosMagento.sql:28-29, SpVTASVentaCupon.sql:48-49).
- No doc declares it deprecated. On 2026-09-11 it was explicitly decided to keep the burn in the order flow (DOC MappingMetods/FLUJO_CREDITO_LAN_VS_SAP.md:188); that decision and PLAN §22.5 #6, Q7/Q8 and B3/B6 would need updating.

Real risk: when LAN is retired, whether or not A/B is done, Magento's checkout and Credilana coupon calls get a null or error answer unless the Magento field is removed first. MAG Omnipro/MaviCredito/Model/CreditoManagement.php:576-609 swallows the error and returns null, and the JS calls response.replace on it without a null check (omnipro_pago_credito-method.js:794, credito-checkout-functions.js:271).

"Codigo promotor" and "codigo recomendador" are separate things in the code (MAG Mavi/ProductosMX/Model/CreditMxManagement.php:457 vs :459; LAN Metodos/Credit/Methods.cs:134).

Docs sweep, read-only. Nothing in the skill docs, runbook, RSG, checklists, mapping CSVs or memory says the promoter coupon ("codigo promotor", SpVTASVentaCupon / VTASCVentaCupon -> VentasCupones) is deprecated. Every record either keeps it or leaves it open:
- 2026-08-03 ODS: VTASCVentaCupon -> SIGMAVI VentaCupon, "Confirmado" (_DECISIONES_ODS.md:175, README.md:66). It was moved from "Fuera de alcance" to Mixto/ours (README.md:49).
- 2026-08-12: E-46 is recorded as "ya construido ... ya en produccion" with open defects (CHECKLIST_DEV3:315, :327-334). Gantt slots are still planned (PLAN_MAESTRO_GANTT_POR_DEV.md:92, :188, :281). _CONTROL_MIGRACION.csv:22 (E-15) says "Listo".
- 2026-09-11 decision: "la quema del cupon se queda en el flujo de la orden" (FLUJO_CREDITO_LAN_VS_SAP.md:188). codigo_promotor was added to InfoClienteRequest "justificado por el contrato" (:186).
- 2026-09-24/25/26: the runbook keeps it as an open parity item: §18.5 #11 (fixed in §20.1), §18.8 SIGMAVI question (W1), §18.9, §22.5 #6 "Open", §22.8 waiting on SIGMAVI, §23.4 Q7/Q8, §23.5 B3/B6, and the §23.6 correction.
- The LAN SP was still being changed on 08/Enero/2026 (SpVTASVentaCupon.sql:49-50).

The only deprecation on record is "codigo recomendador" (D8 / D8.4, FLUJO_SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS_A_CODIGO.md:895-906; workflow_credit_parity_2026-09-26.js:34; memory sap-migration-sp-credito-alcance.md:20). The docs keep the two concepts apart everywhere:
- reuso.md:99 says so explicitly.
- They sit in different array slots: data[69] vs data[72] (PLAN:384 vs :387).
- They hit different tables: VTASCVentaCupon with Personal/Agente (employee) vs CREDIDCodigoRecomendador joined to Cte (customer referral) (resumen_dudas.md:12-13).
- Magento sends them as separate fields (collectionhoppscotch 15092026.json:14259).
One trap: the recomendador program also says "cupon" ("Vigencia de cupon Recomienda y Gana", RecomenderController/Post_SetCodes_Mapping.md:35).

Side effects the docs point to:
1. The coupon row's IdEcommerce is the only link between a credit order and its promoter. SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS @Agente is not passed on either side (credit_parity_2026-09-26.json promo step 15). The SP header gives its purpose as "Identificar origen ventas cupon" (SpVTASVentaCupon.sql:13), and FLUJO_CREDITO:145 says that without the burn "no se le acredita la venta". Removing it stops that attribution for credit orders. No doc names anyone who reads the table.
2. Magento's checkout validation is not affected. It goes Magento -> DMZ credit/codigoPromocion -> LAN (parity step 14), and LAN ValidarCupon counts any row, used or not (SpVTASVentaCupon.sql:64-70). So the burn never changes its answer.
3. Removing it reverses the 2026-09-11 decision and conflicts with the ODS/E-46 records. SKILL.md rules 1 and 5 (:41, :45) say to consult before retiring a coupon SP whose table went to SigMavi. The user's statement should be written down as the decision.
4. In LAN the same table is also written by the cash order SPs, with Codigo='Contado' whenever @Agente is set (SP_eCommerceNuevoPed.sql:630-655; SPVTASPedidosMagento.sql:538-563). ServicioSAP touches VentasCupones only inside HandlePromoCodeAsync (grep: OrderMethods.cs:1044, :1098, :1147).

No RSG item covers promoter coupons. SD23 "Promociones" (Arquitectura_POS_Credito_MAVI_v060325.md:888, :1118) is pricing promotions, and the SD01 partner roles Z1/Z3 (sd01_enviar_pedido.md:48-51, :102-105) are not linked to codigo_promotor in any doc. The mapping entries that do cover it:
- IDs E-46 / E-15 / E-17 / E-51 / S7-03 / F4d.
- Old CSVs: "Por Definir, SAP Promotions" (_GLOBAL_MASTER_DB.csv:5-7, marked unusable in FLUJO_SP:1374).
- dm07_sucursales listed as "Validacion de Tienda / Promotor" (master_migration_summary_unified.md:117).
- Dependencies: SuccessFactors via android-api, the AWS catalog "Codigo de promotor", businesspartner-api AS_GET_ZQBP_AGENTE, and ZAPI_SUCURSALES_SRV.

What removing it would close:
- Option A (only the "Elimina" call): Q8, §22.5 #6, W1 and §18.8's coupon half as far as the credit flow goes, §18.9 "equivalencia del codigo promotor", B3, B6, DEF-A..DEF-D for the burn, MATRIZ G5-06/07/08 and the coupon parts of G5-02/G4-24/G2-39/G4-13, test step (18) and the "codigo_promotor vacio" requirement in B7, plus the extra latency (up to 4 HTTP calls). Q7 stays half open while order/validatecupon still reads VentasCupones.
- Option B (method and route removed too): also Q7 in full, the E-46 defects, INVENTARIO_LOGS_SERVICIOSAP.csv:97-99, and the "BLOQUEADO POR CATALOGOS" note in Manual 26082026:292-293.
- In either option the shared helpers must stay: GetSuccessFactorEmployeeAsync (BusinessPartnerController.cs:175), GetConfiguracionCatalogoAsync (ProductMethods.cs:745/753/761, SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs:528, ProductController.cs:251) and GetSucursalAsync (AccountController.cs:52).

Stale docs to fix at the same time:
- _ALCANCE_MIGRACION_LAN_a_SAP.md:149 and DMZ-Backlog-Migracion-SAP.md:72/:137 say only ValidarCupon exists. Elimina is at OrderMethods.cs:1094.
- COMPARATIVA_SETORDER D-04 says codigo_promotor is missing. It is at InfoClienteRequest.cs:56.
- FLUJO_CREDITO:143 calls the method unreachable. It is called at :708.
- CHECKLIST_DEV3:330 says sap-client=050. AccountMethods.cs:190 uses 110.
- PLAN:102 says "LAN consulta VentasCupones". LAN uses VTASCVentaCupon.
